description: This file defines a middleware component for an ASP.NET Core application that catches application-level exceptions, specifically validation exceptions, and transforms them into standardized HTTP error responses following RFC7807 ProblemDetails format.

classes.name: ExceptionHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class that intercepts exceptions during HTTP request processing and converts validation exceptions into JSON ProblemDetails responses.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Handles the request pipeline, catching RequestValidationException and generating an appropriate RFC7807 ProblemDetails response.
